acceptance: findUnbankedClusters requires both <stem>.lint.json and a non-empty companion check-<stem>.mjs in outDir before crediting a lint-routed cluster as banked.
Deleting or emptying check-<stem>.mjs while leaving <stem>.lint.json in place causes lesson-foundry --gate to report the lint cluster as unbanked (exit 2).
packages/lesson-foundry/README.md documents that wiring check-<name>.mjs into CI is the operator step and that --gate requires both <name>.lint.json and check-<name>.mjs.
title: lesson-foundry: require runnable check-<name>.mjs script before crediting a lint cluster in --gate (#676)
